items.quote: Instead of thinking of what you should say to make the client buy, focus on what you should ask,
items.statement: Focus on asking the right questions to guide the client to their own conclusions.

items.quote: the answer of this question is the client telling himself why he should buy now,
items.statement: Clients respond more powerfully to their own reasons for buying than to sales pitches.

overview: This source chunk contains insights on sales strategies, specifically on client engagement and effective questioning in sales contexts.
